Send out elf units to defend your base.|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Elf Camp''' is a unit spawning tower that could have been unlocked by triumphing [[Cold Ambush]] during the [[Violent Night Event]]. After a player had returned to the lobby, it was claimed through the [[Gift Box]] menu. It could also have been obtained through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|500}} during the [[Violent Night Event]] and [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], and for {{Robux|799}} during the [[The Final Act Event]]. The '''Elf Camp''' is a spawner tower that summons elves. These elves are modernized versions of the enemies that appeared in the [[Violent Night Event]]. At Level 0, it only summons the [[Elf]]. However, with later Levels, it can spawn multiple units at once instead of just one. The functionality of these units varies, making each unit unique. With Levels, some units will be replaced by their stronger variants. For the first upgrade, the '''Elf Camp''' only summons [[Elf|Elves]], which can only collide with enemies. This unit is later replaced with the [[Guardian Elf]], which can also damage enemies with its sword. At Level 1, it can spawn an additional unit, the [[Snowball Elf]], that throws snowballs at enemies from a distance, dealing damage. It is replaced by the [[Cannoneer Elf]] at Level 2, which deals more DPS, and by the [[Gunner Elf]] at Level 3, which fires in bursts and at Level 4 spawns twice, dealing even more DPS. At Level 2, it can also spawn the [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]], which explodes upon death, dealing damage to enemies in its explosion radius. It is replaced by the [[Gift Bomber]] at Level 4, which instead throws present bombs and flies in a sleigh, allowing it to avoid colliding with non-[[Boss]] enemies. It does not explode upon death. At Level 4, it can also spawn its final unit, the [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]], which throws a large snow boulder at enemies, dealing a large amount of damage to any caught in the explosion radius. The '''Elf Camp''' is considerably an early to mid-game tower as its cheap cost and units such as the [[Snowball Elf]] or [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]] can be quite useful in the early-game, while its later units like the [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]] or [[Gunner Elf]] can be quite useful in the mid-game. As most of the '''Elf Camp''' units have low health, they will often be killed instantly. *Despite being a flying unit, the [[Gift Bomber]] is affected by enemy abilities that damage units, even if it does not look like was not hit by it. *The [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]]'s splash damage can be quite useful at clearing out hordes of enemies that appear early on. **Later on, the [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]] and [[Gift Bomber]] can also prove useful for the stronger hordes of [[Slow Boss]]es, although it takes a while for the projectiles to hit, meaning they could miss faster enemies. ***The [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]]'s snowballs may not hit the path most of the time. *The [[Electroshocker]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Freezer]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] pair well with the '''Elf Camp''' as they slow down enemies before colliding with units, allowing the units to survive longer. *Units spawned by the '''Elf Camp''' are not affected by any buffs or debuffs. *Units spawned by the '''Elf Camp''' are far less effective against [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies as they cannot collide with them and only some of the units can detect them. **The [[Gift Bomber]], despite being a flying unit, cannot collide with [[Flying]] enemies. **However, they are effective against [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, as collision and splash damage deals damage to them. *As the [[Gift Bomber]] is a flying unit, it cannot collide with most enemies. It can only collide with [[Boss]] enemies, like the [[Molten Warlord]] or [[Fallen King]]. *The two [[Gunner Elf|Gunner Elves]] that spawn are not one unit but two. **This means the DPS of both units is effectively doubled at Level 4. ==Trivia== *The elves spawned by this tower are based on multiple enemies that appear in the [[Violent Night Event]]. **The [[Elf]] is based on the [[Basic Elf (Cold Ambush)|Basic Elf]]. **The [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]] is based on the [[Bomber Elf (Cold Ambush)|enemy of the same name]]. **The [[Guardian Elf]] is based on the [[Cookie Guard (Cold Ambush)|Cookie Guard]] **The [[Gift Bomber]] is based on the [[Sleigh (Cold Ambush)|Sleigh]]. **The [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]] is based on the [[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|enemy of the same name]]. ***The [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]] is the first humanoid unit to use a body similar to R15. **The [[Snowball Elf]], [[Cannoneer Elf]] and [[Gunner Elf]] do not appear to be based on any enemies from the event. ***Though the [[Gunner Elf]] does use the same accessories as the [[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)|Builder Elf]]. *This is the first tower that can spawn multiple different units at once. **It is also the first event tower to spawn units. *The Level 2 upgrade cost is likely a reference to the year the '''Elf Camp''' was added in. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic
